title: Second and third conditionals: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: If I ___ more time, I would read more.
items.explanationEs: Condicional 2: después de if, pasado simple (had). Would va solo en el resultado.

items.prompt: If you had asked me, I ___ you.

items.statement: If I were you, I'd buy the blue one.
items.explanationEs: If I were you (yo que tú) + would: un consejo.

items.statement: If she would know the answer, she would tell us.
items.explanationEs: Después de if no va would: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.

answers: What would you do if you won the lottery?
items.explanationEs: Situación imaginaria: would en la pregunta y pasado simple después de if (won).

answers: We would have arrived earlier if we had taken a taxi.
items.explanationEs: Condicional 3: would have + participio, y had + participio después de if.
